items.evidence: Each of the 12 tranches of the 2018 CEO Performance Award vested upon certification by the Board that both (i) the market capitalization milestone
any one of the following eight operational milestones focused on revenue or eight operational milestones focused on profitability, was met
the market capitalization milestone for such tranche, which began at $100 billion for the first tranche and increased by increments of $50 billion thereafter
a sustained incremental $4 billion increase in Tesla's market capitalization from $3.2 billion
a specified operational milestone relating to development of Model X or Model 3, aggregate vehicle production or a gross margin target

equal_split.evidence: divided equally among 12 separate tranches that were each equivalent to 1% of the issued and outstanding shares
